params.name: hash
params.description: Hex-encoded SHA-1 hash of the attachment (40 characters)

items.docs:
Get an attachment by its hash. Attachments are content stored in the Atlas network.

The attachment hash is a 40-character hex string (SHA-1 hash).

params.name: pages_indexes
params.description:
Comma-separated list of page indexes to query.
- Maximum 8 pages per request
- Each index must be 0-4294967295 (u32 range)
- Values outside u32 range return 400 Bad Request

items.docs:
Get inventory of attachments for a given index block hash and page range.
This returns a bitfield indicating which attachments are available.
